Package de.labathome.trustconstr.records

Class State

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.records.State
Direct Known Subclasses:
StateIP
public class State extends Object
Mutable state threaded through the equality-path SQP outer loop. Updated once per iteration by MinimizeTrustConstr.updateState(de.labathome.trustconstr.records.State, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, boolean, de.labathome.trustconstr.ScalarFunction, de.labathome.trustconstr.records.PreparedConstraint[], long, double, double, de.labathome.trustconstr.records.CGInfo) and consulted by the user-supplied IterationCallback.
